description: Navigate to the Azure DevOps Pull Requests section for the 'PaymentGateway' repository. Locate PR #1 'Update Payment Gateway SDK' which is currently blocked by branch policies. Configure the PR to 'Auto-complete' when all requirements are met. You must select 'Squash commit' as the merge type and enable 'Delete feature/payment-sdk after merging'. Do NOT approve the PR yourself or attempt to bypass policies.
